comments:
Hey there @tombrien, mind taking a look at this issue as it has been labeled with an integration (`coinbase`) you are listed as a [code owner](https://github.com/home-assistant/core/blob/dev/CODEOWNERS#L173) for? Thanks!
<sub><sup>(message by CodeOwnersMention)</sup></sub>

I assume this is relating to the exchange rate sensors? I think we can increase the precision of those but my question would be why eight digits of precision specifically. My instinct is to leave it at 2 (minimum currency denomination in most currencies) and add an option to allow selecting the precision. How does that sound?

@kiranbhakre this looks to have just sneaked in in time for the next release. You should have a read of the updated docs, during my testing I found that sometimes you won't get the number of decimals desired since Coinbase doesn't send data which is that accurate.

> The number of decimals calculated in exchange rate sensors, a smaller number of decimal places may be returned when the upstream data from Coinbase lacks sufficient precision, this is usually the case when the exchange rate is much larger than the base currency and thus should have no significant effect on calculations.

review_comments: We only prefix constants that represent config keys with `CONF_`. Default values we usually prefix with `DEFAULT_`.
